galleries.description: A selection of portraits by James Croucher.

photos.alt: An older man with a long white beard and a wide-brimmed hat stands before a weathered ochre stone wall, a smiling woman resting her hand on his shoulder.
A woman in a brown cardigan sits in low evening sunlight beside tall windows overlooking a city, smiling as she looks toward the light.
A man in a pilot's uniform with four gold stripes on each sleeve buttons his jacket in the leather-lined cabin of a private jet.
A bald man in a burgundy suit leans against a green wall beside a barred, boarded-up window, smiling off to one side.
A grey-bearded man in glasses, a denim shirt and a peace-sign T-shirt stands with his hands in his pockets against a mottled brown backdrop.
